Leverage YARN's REST API client libraries for ResourceManager interactions.

Use deployment properties to dynamically configure YARN app instances, queues, and priorities.

YARN ResourceManager REST APIs are accessible and stable for integration.

Documentation and test cases can be completed in parallel with core implementation tasks.

activities.activity_description: Implement automatic deployment of YARN applications to HDFS using xd-admin and manifest files.
Develop REST client logic to negotiate with YARN ResourceManager for grouped module deployments, handling appType and appName specifics.
Add support for deployment properties to configure distinct YARN app instances with varying queues and priorities.
Refactor deployer to operate asynchronously, returning control to the shell and queuing deploy operations as YARN tasks.
Resolve and inject module-dependent JARs into the Spring Boot loader for external library support.
Refactor ModuleLauncher to use Spring Boot's JarLauncher API, eliminating duplicate functionality.
